skus.notes: Crew-neck short-sleeve cotton 100% (COTTON 100% คอกลม). Supplier SAMARN GARMENT (สมานการ์เม้นท์), model SM-series. Same garment offered in both crew (คอกลม) and V-neck (คอวี) per labels. Hero = clean single blue (ฟ้า) tee on mannequin, white bg, ideal for bg-removal. Gallery adds ฟ้าน้ำทะเล/ฟ้าอ่อน/ฟ้าเข้ม + a folded multi-color blue lay. color_charts index 2 & 3 are the full SM-code color matrices (SM001-SM025). Sizes S-4XL (rounds 32-54in) per size chart (folder1 #01).

skus.notes: V-neck short-sleeve cotton 100% (COTTON 100% คอวี). Same SAMARN GARMENT model as EX001 but V-neck cut — all single mannequin shots in folder2 are clearly V-neck. Hero = clean single red (แดง) V-neck on mannequin, white bg. Gallery: orange (ส้ม) #09, coral (โอรส) #08, gray V-neck mannequin #04, paired gray V-necks #01. Shares the same color matrix charts (index 2 & 3) — labeled 'คอกลม/คอวี' so available colors mirror EX001. Maps to candidate EX007 (V-neck NEW).
